subject: Provenance & Staging Schedule for Probe Corpus — MAP and Usage Constraints
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@quantaai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: QuantaAI Legal <legal@quantaai.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Probe corpus handover & proposed constraints

Hi Alex / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked very promising. As we discussed, QuantaAI is ready to share a 25k sample probe corpus (derived from anonymized customer interactions) so you can run a short acceptance pass against Redwood’s serving runtime.

High-level asks from our side:
- Staging window: 2 weeks (we’d prefer 2027-05-24 to 2027-06-07).
- Usage constraints: read-only for evaluation, no redistribution, models may be tested but derivatives may not be commercialized.
- Provenance: we will provide a CSV mapping sample_id -> original_source_hash + redaction_flags. We need Redwood to retain that mapping only for the staging window and then destroy it unless otherwise agreed.

Attached: probe-corpus_sample-list.csv (sample index + provenance stub).

Can you confirm you can accept the two-week staging window and the retention constraint? If so, please share a short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones so Legal can provision a brief MPA and we can get this scheduled.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of Product Partnerships
QuantaAI
[attachment: probe-corpus_sample-list.csv]

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@quantaai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Probe corpus handover & proposed constraints

Ellen — thanks for the clear ask and the sample index. We can support the two-week staging window and the retention constraint, with a few operational clarifications below. I’m looping in Karthik (security/compliance) and Monica (customer success/ops) to finalize the MAP and the handoff runbook.

Proposed MAP high-level (draft):
1) 2027-05-24: Secure upload to a mutually accessible staging bucket (Redwood-managed, customer-specified KMS key).
2) 2027-05-25 to 2027-05-26: Redwood-run smoke tests (sanity checks, hash verification with your CSV).
3) 2027-05-27 to 2027-06-04: Acceptance testing window (you run any workload tests remotely; we can run observer-mode token-level traces).
4) 2027-06-05: Closeout review and flag any exceptions.
5) 2027-06-07: Confirmed destruction of provenance mapping and test artifacts unless QuantaAI requests extension in writing.

Questions / clarifications:
- KMS: do you want Redwood to encrypt with your customer-managed key (bring-your-own-key) or use Redwood-managed key for the staging bucket?
- On the “no derivatives for commercialization” clause: can we allow internal benchmarking and model tuning for non-commercial research (we will not export any derivative datasets)?
- Do you require an on-prem dry run (you mentioned that possibility) or will a remote observer run be sufficient?

I attached a quick draft MAP (draft_MAP_Quanta_v2.pdf) with milestones and owners — please review and mark redlines.

Next step: if QuantaAI is ok with the draft MAP, we’ll route a short MPA to Legal for signatures (we can support DocuSign).

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: draft_MAP_Quanta_v2.pdf]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Ellen Park <ellen@quantaai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Probe corpus handover & proposed constraints

On Tue, May 18, 2027 at 11:06 AM Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ellen — thanks for the clear ask and the sample index. We can support the two-week staging window and the retention constraint, with a few operational clarifications below. I’m looping in Karthik (security/compliance) and Monica (customer success/ops) to finalize the MAP and the handoff runbook.
> 
> Proposed MAP high-level (draft):
> 1) 2027-05-24: Secure upload to a mutually accessible staging bucket (Redwood-managed, customer-specified KMS key).

Thanks Alex — a couple of redlines from Security/Legal perspective:
- KMS: if QuantaAI provides a customer-managed key, we need confirmation that key policies allow Redwood’s service principal to decrypt for the duration of the staging window. If not, we will require a Redwood-managed key with an attestable access log.
- Retention: security prefers a cryptographic-hash-only proof to be retained for audit instead of the full provenance CSV. Will QuantaAI accept retention of only sample_id -> sha256(sample) + redaction_flag for our audit and then destroy the mapping?
- Access controls: only Reader and Observer personas to be granted to Redwood engineers during the window; no download permissions for raw files.

Attached: security_controls_snippet.pdf (excerpts we’d like to include in the MPA).

Kimberly Park
Principal Security PM, Redwood Inference
[attachment: security_controls_snippet.pdf]

From: Ellen Park <ellen@quantaai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: QuantaAI Legal <legal@quantaai.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Probe corpus handover & proposed constraints

Thanks team — we can accommodate the security asks with one adjustment:
- We will provide the sample_id -> sha256(sample) + redaction_flag (no original_source_hash).
- For KMS, we will rotate a temporary CMK with a policy that allows Redwood’s service principal to access for the staging window only; rotation schedule will be shared.
- Observer-mode: remote observer run is acceptable to QuantaAI for this initial exchange (we will revisit on-prem after the first acceptance).

One more ask from Legal: can you add an explicit clause in the MAP that prohibits export of any derivatives for commercial use for 12 months post-staging? Our counsel prefers a time-bound clause rather than an unlimited restriction.

If you can add that clause, we’re ready for a signature and to schedule the upload on 2027-05-24 morning (PST).

Best,
Ellen Park
Head of Product Partnerships
QuantaAI

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@quantaai.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Final MAP & next steps (DocuSign + staging checklist)

Ellen / team — thank you for the quick turnaround and the clarifications. Per the thread we’ve updated the MAP to reflect:
- Provenance retention: only sample_id -> sha256(sample) + redaction_flag retained for audit; full mapping will be destroyed on 2027-06-07 unless an extension is requested in writing.
- KMS: QuantaAI will provision a temporary CMK with a limited policy; Redwood will use the key for the staging bucket only during the agreed window.
- Usage constraint: explicit 12-month non-commercial derivative restriction added to Section 4.2 of the MAP.
- Access roles: Reader/Observer only for listed Redwood engineers; no download on raw files.

Attachments: finalized_MAP_Quanta_signedready.pdf (we will send this to Legal via DocuSign once you confirm). Also attached is the staging checklist with owners and runbook steps.

Next actions:
1) Ellen — reply with approval to proceed and confirm morning of 2027-05-24 PST for upload.
2) QuantaAI Legal — if you are on this thread please confirm that the 12-month clause is acceptable and we will route for DocuSign.
3) Monica — please prepare the staging bucket and templated access roles; coordinate keys with QuantaAI.

If I don’t hear objections by EOD tomorrow we’ll kick the DocuSign flow.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[attachment: finalized_MAP_Quanta_signedready.pdf]
